authorize.title: Connect to Nutness
authorize.description:
A Nutness page opens: sign in, check your club credentials, then authorize this Home Assistant.

Code shown on the page: **{code}**

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Nutness
reauth_confirm.description: This Home Assistant's access was revoked or your club account was removed. Reconnect it.

abort.cannot_connect: The Nutness server does not respond. Try again later.
abort.denied: Access denied on the Nutness page.
abort.expired: The 10 minute delay is over. Start again.
abort.already_configured: This account is already linked to this Home Assistant (key updated).
abort.wrong_account: This is not the same account as the integration's.

data_description.notify: Notification service (mobile app…) or Home Assistant notification.

reserver.name: Book a class
reserver.description: Books a class, or joins the waiting list if it is full. More than 72 h before the class, the booking is made automatically when registrations open.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the class (first day for the schedule).

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several Nutness accounts are linked.

annuler.name: Cancel a class
annuler.description: Cancels a booking, a waiting list spot or a planned booking.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the class (first day for the schedule).

config_entry_id.name: Account

date.name: Date
